remarks: Welcome to Highview Terrace! Enjoy comfortable, move-in-ready living in this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo in sought-after Springdale! Freshly painted and featuring new lighting, blinds, and countertops, this inviting home offers a spacious eat-in kitchen, roomy balcony, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Bonus feature: A huge, private storage room with a loft! This versatile space is perfect for a home office, workout area, workshop, or additional storage.  Two reserved parking spaces are included, along with plenty of visitor parking. Conveniently located near Metro-North, bus lines, the Merritt Parkway, and I-95. You'll love the easy access to transportation and all that Springdale has to offer. Rental requirements: Excellent credit and references required. One month security deposit.
